title: 2024 Madeiran regional election
summary: A snap regional election was held in Madeira on 26 May 2024, more than three years before the legislature was due to end, after Miguel Albuquerque resigned as president of the regional government on 5 February, having been named a suspect in a corruption investigation. The Social Democrats came first again and again without a majority, and Albuquerque returned to office. In December the assembly approved a motion of censure against him, and a third election followed in March 2025. It is in the atlas as the middle of the only sequence of three elections in eighteen months anywhere in the Portuguese system.
